content.short: Rocket Pool lets users run network nodes or stake ETH to earn annual staking rewards.
content.description: Rocket Pool, established in 2016 by founder and CTO David Rugendyke, is a liquid Ethereum staking protocol. It enables participation in staking on Ethereum’s consensus layer (ETH2) and rewards users with up to 8.24% annually, paid as rETH tokens that can be swapped at any time. The protocol is decentralized and governed by the RPL token via a network DAO. Users can also stake ETH and operate validator nodes to confirm transactions, earning up to 6.77% annual ETH rewards in addition to RPL rewards.
